description: Change the vault passphrase without re-encrypting any stored secrets. Re-derives the KEK from the new passphrase and re-wraps the unchanged master key. Operator-only.
embedding_description: Vault: rotate the passphrase without re-encrypting any stored secrets. Re-derives the KEK from the new passphrase via PBKDF2 + re-wraps the unchanged DEK (master key) under the new KEK + replaces the persisted wrapped key atomically. The two-tier KEK/DEK design exists precisely to make this fast. Vault must be unlocked under the old passphrase. Operator-only.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Passphrase rotation result. Contains message confirming the rotation. No secrets were re-encrypted.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the rotation and remind the operator that any recovery passphrase set via vault_create_recovery is unaffected and still valid.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Update any out-of-band records of the operator's vault passphrase. No further vault action is required.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Rotates the vault passphrase by re-deriving the KEK and re-wrapping the unchanged master key.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: VaultNotInitialized: vault_init has not been run. InvalidPassphrase: old_passphrase does not unwrap the master key. EncryptionFailed: KDF or re-wrap operation failed. VaultAccessDeniedError: caller is not operator.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For VaultNotInitialized: run vault_init first. For InvalidPassphrase: verify the old passphrase; if forgotten, unlock via the recovery passphrase and rotate from there. For VaultAccessDeniedError: re-invoke from operator-MCP context.
